# Sourdough starter care

Feed the starter equal weights of flour and water every twelve hours at room temperature. A healthy starter doubles within six hours of feeding.

| Temperature | Feeding interval |
|-------------|------------------|
| 24 C        | 12 hours         |
| 30 C        | 8 hours          |
| 5 C (fridge)| 7 days           |
